blocking_issues.finding: The 40/40 extraction result uses circular gold construction.
blocking_issues.evidence: Every message constructor derives expected_text from the extractor being evaluated. Experiments regenerate these expectations instead of loading independent frozen gold. An in-memory mutation that removed 'Deadline: Friday.' still produced 40/40 extraction success and 11/11 decision/condition preservation.
blocking_issues.impact: The headline cannot support independent extraction correctness or complete preservation. The narrower checks against explicit labeled strings remain useful. E2 completion needs corrected evidence or a narrower claim.

blocking_issues.finding: The reported end-to-end accepted attribution error excludes false-positive quote detections.
blocking_issues.evidence: Source-resolution evaluation iterates only over gold quotes. Scoring every augmented prediction with the existing full-context matcher produced 3 incorrect accepted attributions among 18 acceptances. The stored metric reports 0/15. The excluded errors are two reverse attributions in late-parent-arrival and one attribution in the repeated-boilerplate negative control.
blocking_issues.impact: The current end-to-end error label materially misstates attribution performance. Detection precision exposes the false positives, but does not correct the source-resolution denominator.

nonblocking_issues.finding: E4 does not implement the planned held-out template-family split. Both splits use the same five families. Fifteen test examples are content-identical to calibration examples, all in edited_unique. Different seeds do not guarantee disjoint examples.
nonblocking_issues.impact: The numbers remain reproducible generator diagnostics. They do not establish the stated independent family holdout.

nonblocking_issues.finding: Replay scoring has blind spots. stale_final_relations compares history against the same final snapshot and returns zero even when a relation disappears. Quote-policy scoring matches any assessment in a message, so one correct source assessment can satisfy both interleaved gold occurrences. Parent accuracy excludes unexpected relations and the ancestry label.
nonblocking_issues.impact: The current comparator findings remain supported, but these metrics cannot reliably detect several correction, retraction, and occurrence-coverage regressions.

nonblocking_issues.finding: The quote contract conflates alternative sources with jointly required sources. multiple-parents contains distinct text from two known sources, but len(source_candidates) > 1 labels it ambiguous and rewards abstention.
nonblocking_issues.impact: The reported two ambiguous occurrences combine one alternative-source case with one composite quotation. The contract cannot express separate occurrence segments and their required source links.

nonblocking_issues.finding: E2 combines prior-arrival context for reuse detection with complete-case context for source matching. Matching can access a source that arrived after the quote. The end-to-end path also slices expected_text and takes marker handling from gold annotations.
nonblocking_issues.impact: The result is a hybrid diagnostic. It should not be interpreted as attribution performance at arrival time or as a fully independent pipeline evaluation.

nonblocking_issues.finding: Missing regression tests cover the defects above. Existing tests do not enforce independent extraction gold, content-disjoint calibration/test splits, inclusion of false accepted attributions, occurrence-specific replay scoring, or detection of stale and removed relations.
nonblocking_issues.impact: Passing tests and stable hashes establish reproducibility, but do not establish metric validity.

recommended_fixes: For B1, define expected bodies independently of extract_body and evaluate against frozen gold without regenerating it. Add an in-memory corruption test that must reduce preservation or extraction accuracy.

For B2, score all predicted quote occurrences with one-to-one gold assignment. Count accepted sources attached to unmatched occurrences as false attributions. Retain gold-conditioned diagnostics under explicit names.
For N1, enforce content-disjoint splits. Implement the promised family holdout or narrow the plan and status to same-family generator diagnostics. Select thresholds only on calibration data.

For N2, score replay assessments by occurrence identity and source span. Test resolved-to-ambiguous transitions, removed relations, and deliberately stale assessments against independent expected states.
For N3, distinguish alternative-source sets from composite quotations with multiple required source segments.
For N4, state the source-availability policy for each metric. Use extracted prediction text and detector metadata in the end-to-end path.

After correcting the affected metrics, regenerate results and audit records. Revise E1–E4 completion statements to match the validated scope. These are harness and research-status fixes; they do not require product design changes.
verified_points: Read all requested documents, Python modules, tests, metrics, and final audit locally. No files were changed and no network access was used.

E4 threshold selection uses calibration examples only. The recorded test diagnostic includes one incorrect near-collision acceptance among 81 acceptances. General calibration and production reliability remain assigned to Topic 10.
